nodes.label: ALD Sky/FX Anchor
nodes.rationale: A persistent Empty holding vertical axis, ground elevation and units scale; identified by UID so it survives rebuilds, and it feeds gravity and launch points to every solver.

nodes.label: Atmospheric Smoke (ALD | Smoke volume)
nodes.rationale: A real volumetric object rendered by the environment (B layer), so it is not subject to the additive FX coverage.

nodes.label: Per-System FX Clock (Timeline / Preview / Burst Age)
nodes.norm_label: per-system fx clock (timeline / preview / burst age)
nodes.rationale: fx.set_age writes the Age Offset of the modifiers instead of rebuilding: the slider never recreates objects or rewrites the deterministic data.

nodes.label: FX Particle Material Contract
nodes.rationale: role/age_norm/energy/trail_u/stable_noise/event_color drive the shader; missing attributes keep neutral values so older files never go black.

nodes.label: Analytic FX Particle Solver
nodes.rationale: Particles are evaluated analytically from hashed per-particle data, so results are independent of frame history and frame rate; the stable form avoids cancellation for small drag.

nodes.label: FX 3D Particle Systems (fx.py / ALD | FX)
nodes.rationale: Physical 3D fireworks and meteors with real depth, gravity and overlap, separate from the world shader's sky, clouds, stars and Milky Way.

nodes.label: Geometry Nodes FX Backend (ALD | FX Burst GN / Trail GN)
nodes.norm_label: geometry nodes fx backend (ald | fx burst gn / trail gn)
nodes.rationale: The frame handler writes no geometry in this path: 2.5 ms/frame against 121.7 ms for the Python writer.

nodes.label: Fix: _update_meteors NoneType Crash
nodes.rationale: The non-GN path stores trail/head/fragment objects per event, so the updater must iterate system['events'] instead of the always-None system['trail'/'heads'/'fragments'].

nodes.label: Burst Age Slider Without Rebuild (2.3 ms vs 428 ms)
nodes.norm_label: burst age slider without rebuild (2.3 ms vs 428 ms)

nodes.label: Geometry Nodes / Python Solver Parity (1 mm)
nodes.norm_label: geometry nodes / python solver parity (1 mm)

nodes.label: Stable Closed-Form Drag Solver (expm1 + series)
nodes.rationale: p0 + v_inf a + (v0 - v_inf) A cancels two large terms for small drag; p = p0 + v0 A + g(a - A)/k with expm1 and a series expansion stays stable, and the velocity uses the same form.

nodes.label: Evaluated Matrix vs Stale matrix_world
nodes.rationale: The raw matrix_world can be stale right after a move and ignores constraints; obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph).matrix_world honours parents and constraints.

nodes.label: God Rays (Glare Sun Beams)
nodes.rationale: The Sun Beams node is always created when god_rays is on; with the sun behind the camera it starts at (0.5,0.5) with strength 0 so the frame handler can find it later.

nodes.label: Rim Emission wiring
nodes.rationale: Emission bypasses diffuse attenuation so the rim reads in backlight; the wiring skips materials that already have emission and restores the originals on clear.

nodes.label: Rim Light (Fresnel band)
nodes.rationale: Raw Layer Weight Facing covered 68% of the gate frame; the MapRange (1 - Rim Width .. 1) threshold curve keeps it edge-local at ~6.5%.

nodes.label: ALD | Shadow Tint group (v2)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in and reversible: MULTIPLY mix preserves texture detail, palette shadow colors are normalized multipliers, and clearing restores the original Base Color link or value. Toggle off zeroes AO while Cel/Rim stay on.

nodes.label: Auto Sun
nodes.rationale: Applying a palette creates ALD | Sun only when the scene has no SUN light, so user lights are never deleted or retinted.

nodes.label: Shadow Hue Lift
nodes.rationale: A pure multiply on warm materials cannot produce a blue shadow; a small additive tint veil gives the cool hue without losing texture.

nodes.label: Glare Sun Position Convention (0..1, y up)
nodes.norm_label: glare sun position convention (0..1, y up)

nodes.label: AO Node Works in EEVEE Next and Cycles (5.1.2)
nodes.norm_label: ao node works in eevee next and cycles (5.1.2)

nodes.label: Headless Verification Gate (preset_dev/verify.py)
nodes.rationale: Must print ALD GATE: PASS after every change; structural checks alone missed a light-wrap bug, so the gate also does render-level pixel checks.

nodes.label: Blender 5.1 Node-Group Compositor API
nodes.rationale: scene.node_tree is None and CompositorNodeComposite does not exist; Glare is socket-driven and ShaderNodeSeparateColor must be replaced by CompositorNodeSeparateColor.

nodes.label: Scene Properties / View3D Sidebar Parity
nodes.rationale: Panels never draw state themselves: shared draw_* functions mean the two surfaces cannot diverge, and the gate fails when they do.

nodes.label: Off-Screen Window Yields Black Screenshot
nodes.rationale: A minimized or off-screen Blender window captures black; restore with ShowWindow(hwnd, 9) and move it on screen before capturing.

nodes.label: ALD | Compositor Stack
nodes.rationale: One node group per scene (Render Layers -> Glare -> Sun Beams -> Kuwahara -> Light Wrap -> Ink -> Lensdist -> Group Output); a full rebuild costs ~5-8 ms so slider updates can be synchronous, and update_params (0.34 ms) rewrites sockets instead of rebuilding.

nodes.label: Kuwahara Painterly Filter (geometry-masked)
nodes.rationale: ALD | Kuwahara Geometry multiplies the depth factor so the sky and stars are never smeared by the painterly filter.

nodes.label: Light Wrap
nodes.rationale: Mask = outer silhouette band + depth-discontinuity band; the depth threshold is baked from the camera clip end at build time.

nodes.label: Bypass / Remove ALD / Detach and Keep Result
nodes.norm_label: bypass / remove ald / detach and keep result
nodes.rationale: Three distinct intents: stop touching the scene, remove completely (restore snapshot), or keep the look while dropping management.

nodes.label: Snapshot / Restore Lifecycle (ald_snapshot, REMOVED state)
nodes.rationale: snapshot.ensure runs before every mutation path so a user without a palette apply can still get their world, sun, materials and compositor back; ald_maintenance suspends handlers during the restore.

nodes.label: In-Place Slider Updates (0.34 ms vs 5.28 ms)
nodes.norm_label: in-place slider updates (0.34 ms vs 5.28 ms)

nodes.label: Premultiplied Alpha / Straight Alpha Trap
nodes.rationale: SetAlpha replaces alpha but leaves RGB full, so AlphaOver on a premultiplied render leaks blurred RGB over the whole frame unless Straight Alpha = True; this caused the first global haze.

nodes.label: Persistent FX Schema (ALD_FX_System / ALD_FX_Event)
nodes.rationale: The saved file is the source of truth; the runtime registry is only a cache, and objects are found by (event UID, role) so user renames never break the registry.

nodes.label: baseline.json (version, hashes, schemas, flows)
nodes.rationale: Hashes change on every edit, so the audit relies on the flow invariants: create/update keep 1 record and 14 objects, duplicate changes the UID but keeps 14, remove drops record and geometry together.

nodes.label: N01 Occlusion Leak (particle drawn through wall)
nodes.norm_label: n01 occlusion leak (particle drawn through wall)
nodes.rationale: The FX-only layer excluded the environment, so F had no depth against occluders; the old test passed even when FX leaked and was never called by main().

nodes.label: N02 Zero FX Is Not the Identity
nodes.norm_label: n02 zero fx is not the identity
nodes.rationale: The FX layer contributed the world and other emissive surfaces, so a scene with zero FX changed pixels; OFF and FX3D must render identically with no systems.

nodes.label: Read-Only Diagnostic Ending in UNKNOWN
nodes.rationale: event_state evaluated the depsgraph during draw() and claimed OK; the panel now shows a cached report and only ald.fx_diagnose may prove a projection.

nodes.label: Persistent Scene UUID Identity (ald_fx_id)
nodes.rationale: A hash of the scene name collided across files with the same scene name; a persistent UUID plus a load_post cache clear fixes phantom systems.

nodes.label: P0 Baseline — Evidence and Expected Failures
nodes.norm_label: p0 baseline — evidence and expected failures

nodes.label: FX Recomposition Contract C = (1-A)*Painted_B + F + Glare(F)
nodes.norm_label: fx recomposition contract c = (1-a)*painted_b + f + glare(f)
nodes.rationale: EEVEE writes Alpha=1 even with a transparent world override, so coverage A must be max(R,G,B) of the FX-only render, not alpha; the painterly filters run on a base without FX and F is added premultiplied with Factor 1.

nodes.label: Rejected DIFFERENCE-Based FX Emission Masking
nodes.rationale: The DIFFERENCE of two emission passes is algebraically invalid and produced false contributions from surfaces revealed behind the FX (N06 counterexample); replaced by the base/FX-only/coverage pipeline.

nodes.label: ALD | World Gradient group
nodes.rationale: Hosts the sky gradient, sun disk, stars, clouds and the legacy sky FX; palette colors are wired through group sockets (never baked into ColorRamp stops) and the ald_build marker forces older graphs to rebuild.

nodes.label: Four-Zone Sky Gradient
nodes.rationale: A dedicated mid-sky bridge avoids the muddy blue/orange midpoint produced when complementary sky colors mix.

nodes.label: Perspective Planar Anime Clouds
nodes.rationale: The view ray is projected onto a curved atmospheric deck so clouds stretch into layered bands near the horizon; Cloud Flatness blends billowy cumuli (0) with flat strata (1).

nodes.label: Visible-Sky / Ambient Split
nodes.rationale: World Strength controls ambient light only; camera rays keep the full vivid gradient so cel shadows are not washed out.

nodes.label: Gnomonic Contrail Coordinates (X/Z, Y/Z)
nodes.rationale: Spherical level sets and the curved-shell projection both bend straight filaments into arcs; gnomonic coordinates keep them straight.

nodes.label: _sample_cloud_density (rho, envelope, warped_pos)
nodes.rationale: The solar derivative samples a low-frequency envelope rather than the full density, removing internal Cloud Light speckles while keeping the silhouette pixel-identical.

nodes.label: Per-Camera Palette Overrides
nodes.rationale: Precedence camera > marker > scene palette keeps the base palette intact for shots without an override.

nodes.label: Effective Palette Precedence (camera > marker > base)
nodes.rationale: Markers must never write Scene.ald.palette: look.apply stores ald_effective_palette/source so the base palette survives for shots without an override.

nodes.label: Guarantees and Limits of the Add-on
nodes.norm_label: guarantees and limits of the add-on
nodes.rationale: Never saves the .blend, rebuilds are idempotent, shadow tint is a contact/occlusion proxy not a relighting, God Rays need a rebuild when sun/camera move without a frame change.

nodes.norm_label: absent fx particles (no firework or meteor visible)

nodes.norm_label: no geometry silhouette or horizon line

nodes.label: Seven Atmosphere Presets
nodes.rationale: Scene-Linear Rec.709 color script calibrated for AgX; HDR values above 1.0 are expected and compressed by AgX.

nodes.label: Reference Art Study for Palette and Cloud Calibration
nodes.norm_label: reference art study for palette and cloud calibration
nodes.rationale: Confirms Perlin-Worley plus directional shading over volumetric raymarching, and sources Ghibli limited palettes, Nubis Perlin-Worley, Genshin sky parameterization and iQuilez fBm/domain warping.
